news.title: Aaron Sorkin, Mikey Madison, Jeremy Allen White: The director and cast behind the Facebook sequel
news.summary: Fifteen years after "The Social Network", Aaron Sorkin is taking on Facebook again. His new film, "The Social Reckoning", looks at what the platform has become and the role it plays in division, extremism and misinformation in America, themes that have fuelled his long-running public feud with Mark Zuckerberg. It tells the true story of Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen, played by Oscar-nominated actress Mikey Madison ("Anora"), who leaked thousands of internal documents to Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz, played by Jeremy Allen White ("The Bear").

news.title: Russian attack on Ukraine busses part of 'a steady increase in attacks on civilians'
news.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Thursday there would be a response to a Russian strike that hit two buses in the frontline city of Kramatorsk, killing 30 people and wounding 18 others. France 24's Andrew Hilliar says it comes a bid a growing number of Russian attacks on civilians in the country, with UN figures showing that more civilians had been killed in Ukraine as of August this year than in all of 2025.

news.title: The Russian-occupied town in Ukraine facing starvation
news.summary: Trapped and facing starvation, residents of the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine risk their lives to travel for hours by foot and bicycle along mine-strewn roads to get food and water. The town near the Ukrainian city of Kherson on the war's southern front has been under Russian control since 2022. Since May, food deliveries have dried up, and now former residents and Ukrainian refugees are trying to sound the alarm.

news.title: As elections near, how are French political parties reacting to student protests?
news.summary: Students in France are pledging to keep taking to the streets despite the country's prime minister making a speech on Wednesday in which he said the government would come up with a plan to address their concerns. How have political parties in France been reacting to the movement? Delano D'Souza has been finding out.

news.title: Senegal-Morocco AFCON title decision within days, says CAS
news.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport to rule within days on appeal against decision to strip Senegal of AFCON title.

news.title: Two Latvian men arrested at UK base housing US and NATO intelligence hubs
news.summary: British ​counter-terrorism police are investigating after two Latvian men were arrested Thursday near a Royal Air Force ​base in southeast England housing US and NATO intelligence operations, police said in a statement. The arrests come days after a major incident at another UK base led the US military to withdraw B-1 bombers stationed there.

news.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
news.summary: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.

news.title: French, US and Russian astronauts return to Earth after eight months in space
news.summary: SpaceX brought France's Sophie Adenot and fellow astronauts Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway and Andrey Fedyaev back to Earth on Thursday after an eight-month mission on board the International Space Station that saw Adenot become the first French woman to walk in space.

news.title: Ucrania reivindica un ataque contra la mayor refinería de petróleo de Rusia
news.summary: El Ejército de Ucrania ha reivindicado este jueves un ataque contra la mayor refinería de petróleo del país, situada en la región de Omsk, en el sur del país, cerca de la frontera con Kazajistán.

news.title: #IAmJaneDoe: A campaign in solidarity with Cornell alleged gang-rape victim
news.summary: A wave of videos is spreading across social media under the hashtag #IAmJaneDoe to express solidarity with an anonymous Cornell University student who alleges she was sexually assaulted by several members of a fraternity in 2024.

news.title: EEUU imputa a Maduro y su esposa por liderar un sistema de represión y torturas en Venezuela
news.summary: La Fiscalía de Estados Unidos ha imputado este jueves al presidente de Venezuela, Nicolás Maduro, y su esposa, Cilia Flores, por delitos de tortura contra personas detenidas, incluyendo ciudadanos estadounidenses, en el marco de un "sistema de represión que recurría a la violencia contra la oposición política, la detención arbitraria y la tortura de personas detenidas".

news.title: ‘A celebration of the hybrid form’: Anne Carson wins Nobel literature prize
news.summary: Canadian poet, essayist and translator Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in literature Thursday for playful, genre-blending works that fuse the classical and the modern. Artist, podcast host and writer Mia Funk joined France 24 to discuss Carson’s work.

news.title: Student protesters 'showing no signs of backing down'
news.summary: Students who have been protesting classroom conditions in France for days are "not looking like they are willing to back down", says France 24 reporter Claire Paccalin, despite promises by the French prime minister to bring in measures to address their grievances.

news.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
news.summary: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

news.title: Report alleges Ambassador Guilfoyle improperly asked a donor to pay her credit card bill. Rubio refuses to comment
news.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters that he would not discuss the allegations contained in a Wall Street Journal story that said U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle had asked a donor and supporter of President Donald Trump to pay a $100,000 credit card bill just before her confirmation hearing, promising him access to administration officials if he did.

news.title: How long will the global energy crunch last?
news.summary: High energy prices continue to drive inflation and stoke anger among voters around the world. But with more crude oil flowing through the Strait of Hormuz, and governments releasing more emergency fuel stockpiles, how long will the energy crunch last?
